dictionary.description: Words, names and terms Fala should recognize when you dictate.

replacements.description: When you say the spoken form, Fala writes the other one. It matches whole words, ignoring case and accents, before the formatting AI and also with it off. Only the written form goes to the AI.

snippets.description: Say the trigger and Fala inserts the text as it is: a signature, a calendar link, an address. The trigger needs two words or more and matches ignoring case and accents. {data}, {data_extenso} and {hora} (the Portuguese names stay) become the date, the long date and the time of the dictation. The snippet text never goes to the formatting AI.
snippets.twoWords: The trigger needs two words or more.

list.empty: Nothing in the dictionary yet. Add a term, a spoken → written pair or a snippet.

import.title: Import into the dictionary
import.format: One entry per line: a term, or the spoken and written forms separated by a comma, semicolon or tab. Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped. Only new entries are added; nothing in the dictionary changes.
import.readError: Couldn't read the file. It must be UTF-8 text.
import.tooBig: The file is over {{max}} MB; it does not look like a word list.

counts.duplicates_other: {{count}} repeats (already in the dictionary or earlier in the file)

shortcut.instructionToggle: Press the shortcut, say “hello, Fala” and press it again.

ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.description: The AI fixes punctuation and formatting in what you dictated.
ai.privacy: With the AI on, only the text of your dictation goes to Gemini; never the audio, which stays on your machine.
ai.keyDescription: Kept in the system's password vault. You can add or change it later in Settings.

meetings.title: Meetings (optional)
meetings.description: Record calls and classes and get the notes. Test the sound and set up the keys, or do it later in Settings.
meetings.systemDescription: Play a video or join a call and watch the bar move. Nothing is recorded.
meetings.anthropicDescription: Writes the notes from the transcript. It stays in the system keyring and is never shown again.
meetings.micDescription: What you say in the meeting. It stays on this computer until the transcription.

transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: A dedicated hotkey that always applies AI post-processing to your transcription.

copy_last.name: Copy last dictation
copy_last.description: Puts the last dictation on the clipboard.

shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the dictation shortcut starts and stops recording.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Hold to record or tap to toggle
descriptions.push_to_talk: Records while you hold the shortcut
descriptions.toggle: Tap the shortcut to start recording, tap again to stop

models.title: Transcription models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside Fala

enabled.label: Format dictations with AI
enabled.description: Above 15 words, Gemini formats the dictated text. Only the text and the app name leave this computer; the audio never does.
enabled.waitingKey: Waiting for the Gemini key below: nothing is formatted or sent until it is saved.

cleanup.title: How much the AI changes the text
cleanup.description: The same dictation at each level. Applies to the next dictation.
cleanup.raw: uh... so, like, the meeting's gonna be on Tuesday, no, Wednesday at three, and I wanted you guys to bring the numbers, you know
cleanup.inactive: Levels apply only when the AI formats the dictation: turn the AI on and paste the Gemini key.
cleanup.footer: The original is never lost: Undo AI edit, on Home.

verbatim.label: Verbatim
verbatim.description: Keeps every word, even the hesitations; only adds punctuation and fixes transcription errors.
verbatim.example: Uh... so, like, the meeting's gonna be on Tuesday, no, Wednesday at three, and I wanted you guys to bring the numbers, you know?

light.label: Light
light.description: Removes hesitations and false starts and applies your self-corrections; everything else stays in your words.
light.example: The meeting's gonna be on Wednesday at three, and I wanted you guys to bring the numbers.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Also fixes the grammar and splits long sentences, without changing the tone.
medium.example: The meeting will be on Wednesday, at three. I'd like you to bring the numbers.

heavy.label: Strong
heavy.description: Rewrites for clarity and brevity, without adding anything or changing the meaning.
heavy.example: Meeting Wednesday at 3 p.m.; bring the numbers.

apiKey.title: Gemini key
apiKey.description: Stays in the system keyring. Without a key, only the local rules format the text.

disabledApps.title: Apps without AI
disabledApps.description: Text typed into these apps is never sent to Gemini. Use the executable name, such as chrome or code.

appStyles.title: Style per app
appStyles.description: In these apps, the AI also follows the instruction of the chosen style. Only the instruction goes with the text; an app without a style stays as before.

styles.title: Writing styles
styles.description: A name and an instruction for the AI, such as "formal, greet the recipient by name". Saved when you leave the field.
styles.instructionPlaceholder: How the text should come out in this style

meetings.title: Meetings

callPrompt.label: Ask when a call starts
callPrompt.description: When Teams, Zoom, WhatsApp or a meeting in the browser, like Google Meet, opens the microphone, Fala asks whether you want to record. It never records without your click. When the app lets go of the microphone, it asks whether to stop; with no answer and no sound from the call, the recording stops on its own.

mutedApps.title: Don't ask in these apps
mutedApps.description: Calls in these apps show no prompt.

retention.title: Meeting audio
retention.description: How long recorded audio stays on this computer. Without the audio, the transcript, typed notes and notes stay, but you can no longer play a passage or transcribe again.
retention.confirm: The audio of meetings that ended more than {{days}} days ago will be deleted now, and it cannot be recovered. The transcript and notes stay.

cap.title: Recording limit
cap.description: The recording stops on its own at this length; 10 minutes before, Fala warns you and offers one more hour, up to 8 hours in total.

keepAwake.label: Keep the PC awake while recording
keepAwake.description: The PC doesn't sleep while a meeting records; the screen can still turn off. If it sleeps anyway, the recording goes on in the same meeting when it wakes.

meetings.saveFailed: This option could not be saved. Try again.

channel.title: Input channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

pauseMediaWhileRecording.label: Pause media while dictating
pauseMediaWhileRecording.description: Pauses the music and videos playing while you dictate, and resumes only what Fala paused

pauseMediaOnMeeting.label: Pause media while recording a meeting
pauseMediaOnMeeting.description: Pauses the music and videos playing while the meeting records, so they stay out of the recording, and resumes only what Fala paused

outputDevice.title: Output device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep mic open between transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses the GPU (Vulkan) when there is one.

ort.title: ONNX acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

startHidden.label: Start hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Fala when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show tray icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Fala icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker).

position.title: Overlay position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

idlePill.label: Show the pill at rest
idlePill.description: Keeps a quiet pill on screen between dictations; hover it to see the shortcut and click it to open Fala. It hides while an app is full screen.

pasteMethod.title: Paste method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after the text is inserted.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.description: Names and terms Fala should always spell this way. They help supported models recognize what you say, fix the spelling in the text and go to the formatting AI. Fuzzy correction is limited to words using A–Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice activity detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Disabling VAD records raw audio.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove filler words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.audioDeleted: This dictation's audio was deleted; the text stays.

logDirectory.title: Log directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Fala

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview what's new
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Open the first-run wizard on one step, without downloading a model or changing the completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: Recordings to keep
historyLimit.description: How many recent audio recordings to keep. Dictation text has no limit.

recordingRetention.title: Audio recordings
recordingRetention.description: Deletes the audio of old dictations to save space. The text stays in the history.

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-on microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append trailing space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste delay (before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste delay (after)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable paste (beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra recording buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach Fala. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching Fala normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show what's new
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after Fala updates

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What leaves this computer, where it goes and whether it is on right now. This section only shows; each setting stays on its own page.

dictation.name: Dictation
dictation.sends: Never the audio. Only the dictated text, the app name, your dictionary and the instruction of the app's style, if any, with AI on and a key saved, above 15 words and outside the apps without AI.

experimentalPostProcess.name: Post-processing (experimental)
experimentalPostProcess.sends: Never the audio. The text dictated with the post-processing shortcut and the chosen prompt.

meetingTranscription.name: Meeting: transcription
meetingTranscription.sends: The audio of both meeting channels (your microphone and the computer sound), only when you ask for the transcript.

meetingNotes.name: Meeting: notes
meetingNotes.sends: Never the audio. The transcript, your notes, the title, date and time, the note template, the language and the dictionary, only when you ask for notes.

mcp.name: History for assistants (MCP)
mcp.sends: Your dictations (except those made in the apps without AI) and, if you also allow meetings, the meetings not kept only on this computer, never their audio. Read-only, and only when an assistant on this computer asks. Off unless you turn it on in the mcp.toml file in Fala's data folder.
mcp.destination: The local assistant you set up, which may send them to its own provider

telemetry.name: Telemetry, account and Fala server
telemetry.sends: Nothing. Fala has no server, account or telemetry. Apart from the channels above, it only downloads the transcription models, sending none of your data.

keys.title: Where the keys are kept
keys.description: In the system password vault (Credential Manager, on Windows). Fala never shows the value of a key.

audio.title: Where meeting audio is kept
audio.description: In this folder, on this computer. It only leaves for the transcription, when you ask.

decisions.title: Privacy decisions
decisions.description: Each channel above follows a decision recorded in the public repository.

appDataDirectory.title: App data directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Fala stores its data

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: Fala's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

Transcribing sends that audio to ElevenLabs; generating notes sends the transcript and your notes to Anthropic. Transcripts and notes contain third parties' personal data: tell the participants and follow your workplace rules and data protection law.

erase.title: Erase this stretch?
erase.body_one: The audio from {{from}} to {{to}} in both channels and the line in it leave this computer. This cannot be undone.
erase.body_other: The audio from {{from}} to {{to}} in both channels and the {{count}} lines in it leave this computer. This cannot be undone.
erase.bodyNoAudio_one: The line from {{from}} to {{to}} leaves this computer; the audio is already gone. This cannot be undone.
erase.bodyNoAudio_other: The {{count}} lines from {{from}} to {{to}} leave this computer; the audio is already gone. This cannot be undone.
erase.changed_one: The transcript changed. 1 line of the notes cited the erased stretch.
erase.changed_other: The transcript changed. {{count}} lines of the notes cited the erased stretch.

rename.hint: Click to name {{person}} for the whole meeting
rename.label: Name of {{person}}
rename.regenerate: Name changed. Generate the notes again?

people.hint: Names only, separated by commas, no e-mail. They go to Anthropic with the transcript so the notes can suggest who each Person N is.

context.title: Notes context
context.description: Sent to Anthropic with the transcript every time notes are generated.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Who you are and what you work on, up to 300 characters.
profile.placeholder: E.g. PM on the payments team; meetings with customers and engineering.

language.title: Notes language
language.description: Notes come out in this language, even when the conversation mixes languages.

keyterms.title: Dictionary in the transcript
keyterms.description: Sends your dictionary terms to ElevenLabs to get their spelling right. Costs about US$ 0.05 more per hour.

autoNotes.title: Generate notes when it ends
autoNotes.description: When you stop, after the transcript, the notes are written without a click (from 3 minutes and a long transcript on; never for a local-only session).

templates.title: Notes templates
templates.description: Yours are .json files in a Fala folder, edited in any text editor. Fala reads the folder again when you come back to it.
templates.folderDescription: One file per template; the folder's LEIAME.txt explains the fields.
templates.folderError: Could not use the templates folder: {{detail}}

key.label: ElevenLabs key
key.saved: Saved in the system keyring. Meetings are transcribed.
key.missing: Without it, meetings record but are not transcribed. It stays in the system keyring and is never shown again.

notesKey.label: Anthropic key
notesKey.saved: Saved in the system keyring. Notes are written from the transcript.
notesKey.missing: Writes the notes from the transcript. Without it, meetings get no notes. It stays in the system keyring and is never shown again.

errors.dictation_active: Finish the dictation before recording the meeting.
errors.insufficient_disk: Not enough disk space to record (less than 500 MB free).
errors.audio_device: Could not open the microphone or the system audio.
errors.no_audio: This meeting has no saved audio.
errors.missing_key: The provider key is missing from the system keyring.
errors.keyring: The system keyring did not answer.
errors.transcription: Transcription failed. The audio is still saved; try again.
errors.busy: A transcription or notes generation is already running.
errors.notes_edited: These notes were edited. Confirm before generating again.
errors.tool_missing: {{detail}} is not installed or not on the PATH. Install it and open Fala again.
errors.invalid_url: Use a link that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.download: Could not download that link. Download the video in the browser and import the file. ({{detail}})
errors.import_no_audio: That file has no audio track.
errors.import_too_long: That file is longer than 12 hours, the import limit.
errors.erase_too_long: Stretch too long: up to 500 lines at a time.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. See the log.

notice.text: I'm recording this meeting to transcribe it and take my notes. If you'd rather I didn't record, let me know.

delete.title: Delete for good?
delete.body: The transcript, typed notes and notes are erased from this computer. This cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Move to trash?
confirm.body: The audio is deleted now and does not come back. The transcript, typed notes and notes stay in the trash for 30 days.

trash.title: Trash
trash.footer: Meetings in the trash for more than 30 days are deleted automatically.

recover.title: Recover the recording from {{time}} ({{minutes}} min)?
recover.body: Fala closed in the middle of this recording. The audio up to the last second is saved.

home.noKey: Meetings record, but are only transcribed with the ElevenLabs key.

screen.title: Meeting title
screen.tabs: My notes and the AI notes
screen.noNotes: The notes show here once they are generated.
